  "text": "Generating a deterministic Semantic Experience rule and preferring that fallback in a held-out benchmark are separate gates. The shadow-rule distiller uses only independently confirmed/corrected evidence, keeps the latest observation per evidence family, and by default requires at least 8 evidence units from 2 distinct projects, observed dominance of at least 0.80 and a 95% Wilson lower bound of at least 0.65. Semantic-relation contradictions remain excluded from distillation. These support thresholds create an advisory shadow rule; they do not qualify the fallback for host preference.",
